_comment: Root landing page for the Data-Engineering repo. An index, not a dashboard: it quotes no figures and reads no facts file, because each project's own README carries its numbers next to the evidence for them. build_readme_assets.py here is a copy of the one in the PowerBi repo, and the dbt template subfolder has its own older copy - all three are independent on purpose, since a shared generator would couple repos that have no other reason to move together.
_hero_comment: No badges: the shields.io row right under the hero already covers dbt/BigQuery/dbt_artifacts/MIT - baking them into the SVG a second time said nothing new.

hero.name: hero
hero.title: dbt on BigQuery, and what it costs to run
hero.subtitle: A runnable reference project built to be measured, and two adapter overrides for gaps dbt has no config flag for.

banners.name: section-template
banners.title: dbt Template for BigQuery Cost Observability
banners.body: A dbt project with contracts, incremental merges, a snapshot and a custom materialization - built small enough to run on seeds, so the companion Power BI report has something real to observe.

banners.name: section-macros
banners.title: dbt Custom Macros for BigQuery
banners.body: A MERGE that skips rows where nothing actually changed, and native COLLATE on a column so case-insensitive filters stop wrapping every row in UPPER(). Opt in per model, nothing changes for models that do not.
